pre_registration.selection_rule: A1: a configuration with gate deviation 0 is the static baseline itself and is not admissible; A2: admissible candidates must beat the static baseline on calibration retrieval P@5; S1: feasible = (cal_kfold_p5 >= cal_kfold_p5(concat) - 0.005) and (cal_pair_auc >= cal_pair_auc(released gated) - 0.005); S2: argmax cal_retrieval_p5, ties -> cal_pair_auc -> smallest gate deviation; S3: if empty relax the CV filter, then the AUC filter, then take the global maximum cal_retrieval_p5

families.Grank: percentile-rank (PIT) normalised quality gate: gw = clip(sigmoid(lam*(F_cal(qv) - F_cal(qt))), .05, .95); F_cal = tie-aware mid-rank empirical CDF over calibration detections only. Motivated by arXiv:2603.28886 (PIT score commensuration), Wu et al. AIRS 2006 (doi:10.1007/11880592_57), Montague & Aslam 2001, Scheirer et al. ECCV 2010.
families.Ginv: uncertainty-aware relative-reliability gate: gw = clip(sigmoid(lam*z(log qv - log qt)), .05, .95), z fitted on calibration detections only. Motivated by Zhang et al. ICML 2023 (QMF, dynamic uncertainty-aware fusion weights), Che et al. KBS 2025 (auto-weighted measure combination fitted on train only), arXiv:2512.14961 (confidence-weighted fusion).

pre_registration.excluded: F2_lam1 (round-1 winner) is carried as a reference row only: it was already frozen and already evaluated on test by round 1, so it is not a selection candidate of this round.

F2_lam1.note: round-1 frozen winner, reference only (not selectable)
